summary: Discover the power of data analytics in education. Enroll in our Learning Analytics Course to enhance teaching strategies and improve student outcomes.
lede: Education data analytics helps professionals turn learner activity into evidence for improving educational programs. The course covers cleaning educational datasets, connecting LMS, LRS and xAPI data, and building dashboards to examine engagement and learning gaps. Instructional designers, administrators, analysts and learning managers can also explore predictive modeling and data-informed interventions to track progress, assess instructional impact and communicate findings to stakeholders.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals responsible for the design, delivery, and assessment of educational programs in academic and corporate environments.
modules: Foundations of Learning Analytics and Educational Data
Data Architecture: LMS, LRS, and xAPI Integration
Descriptive Analytics: Visualizing Student Engagement Patterns
Diagnostic Analytics: Identifying Learning Gaps and Friction
Predictive Analytics: Modeling Student Success and Retention
Strategic Integration: Reporting and Stakeholder Alignment
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of educational delivery or instructional design. Familiarity with spreadsheet software (Microsoft Excel) is required. No prior programming or advanced statistical knowledge is necessary, as the course focuses on operational application and the use of visualization tools.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
